title: USA PANICS as Bond Collapse FORCES a Global Monetary Reset
speaker: Sean Foo

macro_themes.view: China's Treasury holdings fell from $1.3T to below $620B, rotated into gold; PBoC bought 23 tons last month, buying accelerated after the Iran war.

Bessent's appointment of Judy Shelton opens the door to revaluing US gold (261M oz at $42 official) or issuing gold-convertible Treasury Trust bonds, which would hurt Treasuries and the dollar but boost gold.
US 2026 deficit ~$2T (~6% of GDP) with spending growing twice as fast as revenue, forcing more issuance and higher yields.
Gold now ~25% of central bank holdings vs Treasuries 21%, a reversal from 9% vs 33% a decade ago.

calls.reason: China dumping Treasuries and buying gold (23t last month), central banks now hold more gold than Treasuries, US deficit ~$2T; possible US gold revaluation or gold-convertible Treasury Trust bonds (Judy Shelton) would spark an explosion in gold demand. Central bank buying puts a floor under price.
calls.quote: if it happens, we could see an explosion in gold demand globally. And that means prices will be way higher down the road.

calls.reason: Endless bond issuance and falling foreign demand push yields higher; cites PIMCO that the 10y could hit 6% by end of this year or early 2027 (attributed view he endorses as a risk).
calls.quote: According to PIMCO, the 10-year yield could hit a crazy 6% soon. It might even happen by end of this year or early 2027.

calls.reason: Collapse in confidence in US fiscal discipline and sanctions push countries away from the dollar; gold-backed bonds would amount to admitting the dollar is toast.
calls.quote: They just essentially admitted that the dollar is toast.

notes: No date stated in transcript; listing approx_date 2026-10-13 ('10 hours ago' at catalog time just after midnight Oct 13 Santiago) suggests it was actually posted Oct 12. No price levels beyond gold 'over $4,000'; all views are long-horizon macro. 6% 10y target is PIMCO's, cited approvingly.
